1.0.0.en: Initial release: local control of Narwal robot vacuums over WebSocket: cleaning controls, fan speed, battery/charging/dock status, room cleaning with autocomplete, resilient reconnect, and a full set of Flow cards.

1.0.11.en: Added the Narwal Map widget, removed Last update from the device sensor list, kept status timestamps internal for app/widget use, and improved widget packaging/validation.

1.0.12.en: Improved the Narwal Map widget: map snapshots are now persisted for widget display after app restarts, empty/error states are clearer, and widget preview images were regenerated.

1.0.13.en: Added Freo Z10 Pro / Turbo and Narwal Freo 20 drivers, refreshed app and driver images, corrected Freo 20/JX compatibility metadata, improved selected-room cleaning with active map ids, added current-room status, expanded compatibility discovery, and updated project docs.

1.0.14.en: Fixed fan speed setting one level too low, live status and map stopping after about 10 minutes of cleaning, custom room cleans and remapping not showing as cleaning, and a docked robot staying on returning after finishing a task.

1.0.15.en: Added five suction levels named as in the Narwal app, including Ultra Powerful. A fan speed chosen while docked is now used for the next clean. Fixed whole-home starts that could report success without cleaning, stopped waking a docked robot on every poll, and corrected unnamed room names.

1.1.0.en: Added cleaning mode settings (mode, water level, mop strength, passes and route) used by every clean, and a Clean with settings Flow card that sets them for a single clean of the whole home, the default rooms or one room.

1.1.1.en: The Cleaning mode settings are now stored on robots paired before 1.1.0. Note: the Homey mobile app shows - for dropdown settings on the Advanced Settings page; open a setting to see its value.

1.1.2.en: Fixed Status, Docked and Charging showing docked while the robot cleans on newer Flow 2 firmware, the current room going blank during a clean, a leftover 1.8 m² cleaning area after docking, and flipping between Cleaning and Docked while docking.

1.1.3.en: Docked detection now recognises every off-the-dock signal used across Narwal firmware versions, so older and newer firmware report Docked, Charging and Status consistently.

1.1.4.en: Fixed robots staying on Returning after finishing on the dock (seen on the Freo Z10 Ultra), partial status updates marking a docked robot as undocked, and a robot that left the dock still showing Docked.

1.1.5.en: First App Store release under the app ID com.narwal.global. Local control of Narwal robot vacuums with cleaning mode settings, a Clean with settings Flow card, five suction levels, and reliable status for newer firmware.

1.1.6.en: Pairing now lists Narwal robots found on your network, and paired robots follow IP address changes automatically. Manual IP entry is still available.

1.1.7.en: Redesigned pairing: robots on your network are listed right away and checked one by one, with Retry and Search again. The Connect button no longer covers the fields, and a robot that does not answer shows an error instead of being added incomplete.

1.1.8.en: Restored the original pairing screen design with the layout fixed: the Continue button no longer covers the fields while typing.

1.1.9.en: Fixed the robot search on the pairing screen staying on Searching, and the IP field cursor sitting outside the field. Searching now shows an animation and hides after 5 seconds when no robot is found.

1.1.10.en: Adding a robot from the found-robots list now follows the same steps as entering its IP address, including choosing a room afterwards.

1.2.0.en: Optional Narwal account sign-in (emailed code or password) and a per-robot Connection setting: Local network (default) or Narwal cloud.

1.2.1.en: Choose Local or Cloud once for the whole app in the app settings. In Cloud mode the pairing screen lists the robots on your Narwal account to add.

1.2.2.en: Fixes a crash when a robot reconnects while it is still connecting, stops repeated "connection lost" Flow triggers during an outage, and makes robot commands report their real result.

1.2.3.en: Flow triggers no longer fire twice, rooms are no longer cleared by maps without rooms, and cloud mode now notices when the robot goes offline. Signing out also ends the session at Narwal.

1.2.4.en: Signing in to a Narwal account now asks you to confirm you are 14 or older, and warns that an email code for an address without a Narwal account makes Narwal create one.

1.2.5.en: Refresh status now waits for the robot, the map widget scales its map and no longer reloads on every resize, and the settings and pairing screens handle errors more clearly.

1.2.6.en: A robot now counts as connected only once it answers, so a silent cloud connection no longer flips between connected and disconnected. The status text updates again after reconnecting.

1.2.7.en: More detailed cloud connection diagnostics, to find why some robots stay silent in Cloud mode.

1.2.8.en: Cloud mode now connects to docked robots: the app waits for the robot to wake up and answer instead of reconnecting too early.

1.2.9.en: Cloud mode no longer needs the Narwal phone app to be open: Homey now asks the robot to keep sending its status the way the Narwal app does.
